recipe.summary: A classic Filipino braise of chicken simmered in soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and bay leaves until tender and glossy.
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs and drumsticks, bone-in, skin-on
steps: Combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a bowl and marinate 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Remove chicken from marinade, reserving the liquid, and sear chicken skin-side down until browned, about 4 minutes per side.
Add onion if using and cook 1 minute.
Pour in reserved marinade and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Uncover, stir in brown sugar, and simmer 10 more minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste sauce and adjust with more vinegar or soy sauce if needed.
Serve chicken with sauce spooned over, garnished with green onions, alongside steamed rice.
tips: Don't stir the vinegar into the pot until it's had a few minutes to boil uncovered first — this mellows its sharpness.
For extra flavor, sear the chicken well before braising to build a fond.
Adobo tastes even better the next day, so make it ahead if you can.
